newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune says intramuscular MEDI-493 safe.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune says intramuscular MEDI-493 safe.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said that a dose-escalating, multi-center Phase I/II study showed intramuscular administration of MEDI-493 in infants to be generally safe and well-tolerated at all dose levels.
MEDI-493 is a humanized monoclonal antibody being developed for use in combating pneumonia and bronchiolitis caused by respiratory syncytial virus.
In March, the company reported the drug safe and well tolerated by infants when administered intrvenously.
